definition: Minimum wholesaler local_total_cost found by order-up-to / tuned-adaptive grids, model warm starts, and coordinate descent on each fixed CRN seed. Feasible upper bound on the true hindsight optimum.

rows.note: Feasible hindsight minimum under fixed CRN demand and scripted counterparties. True optimum is ≤ this value.
